questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Let C<sub>NaCl</sub> 
and C<sub>BaSO<sub>4</sub></sub> be the conductances (in S) measured for saturated aqueous solutions of NaCl
and BaSO<sub>4</sub>, respectively, at a temperature T.
Which of the following is false?

options.content: Ionic mobilities of ions from both salts increase with T.
C<sub>NaCl</sub> >> C<sub>BaSO<sub>4</sub></sub> at a given T

questions.explanation:
BaSO4 is sparingly soluble salt but NaCl is completely soluble salt so it will produce more number of ions. That is why
Conductance (NaCl) > Conductance (BaSO4)
